861 Stockdale Road
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$355,500, 6 bed, 3.50 bath, 3,143 SF, MLS# 583337

Lead a creative life in this Contemporary/Modern home. It is a revelation to find such a beautifully designed home that offers such features as a covered patio, wood fence, and stainless-steel appliances. 6 bedrooms, 3 and 1/2 baths. Delight in the extravagance of the garden tub and dual vanities of the master bath all on first floor. Everything you need to turn out great meals is right here in this kitchen with its granite countertops, pantry, and breakfast bar. Enjoy the sunsets from your own comfortable covered front porch. Adding to the benefits:  Solar Panel, corner fireplace, and an upstairs and downstairs family room.  Specializes in elegance and space!

3 full bath, 1 half bath
